clues: This big town stands in a dry part of the world, first built on seven hills. It now spreads out over more hills and low vales at its edge.
At the same hour, snow can fall on the high west side of town. At that same hour, soft rain may fall down in the town core.
For a long stretch of its past, this town lay near empty and left alone. Then in 1878, folk from far lands were sent to live here.
The oldest human statues in the whole world were found at an old site here. Folk lived at that site in the eighth millennium before Christ.
This city is the capital of Jordan, in the heart of the Middle East. It is the hub of the land for state work, trade, and art.
